structure.summary: npm workspaces monorepo 'frisson', ESM, Node >=22.18, API runs TS directly via node src/server.ts. Workspaces apps/api (Fastify 5 + drizzle-orm + better-sqlite3 + zod), apps/web (Vue 3.5 + vue-router + pinia, Vite 6), packages/shared (zod schemas, exports ./src/index.ts, ./src/sorting.ts; tests live in apps/api/test).
structure.apiScripts: dev, start, typecheck, test, db:generate, db:seed, db:backup, db:restore

tests.apiTests: apps/api/test/*.test.ts (crates, ownership, follows, profiles, schema, migration, ...)
tests.webTests: apps/web/src/**/*.test.ts colocated (views/ProfileView, MyProfileView, CrateView, crateActions, components/profile/*, stores/*)
tests.browserChecks: Playwright scripts in .shipyard/checks/<name>.check.mjs importing {startApp, until, deadSpots} from ./lib.mjs; each starts its own API on a temp DB (DATA_DIR tmp, SEED_DEMO_DATA=false, NODE_ENV=development) on a non-default port, prints PASS/FAIL lines. Run with node from repo root.

testCommand: npm test (from repo root). Single file: npm test -w apps/web -- src/views/X.test.ts. Full set: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run lint.

conventions.formatting: Prettier: no semicolons, single quotes, printWidth 100, trailingComma all; .editorconfig 2-space LF.
conventions.linting: ESLint 9 flat config at root (vue essential, vue-ts recommended, prettier skip-formatting). npm run lint.
conventions.typescript: ESM everywhere; tsconfig.base.json + per-package; API runs TS natively.
conventions.testing: Vitest. API tests apps/api/test/*.test.ts named by feature using buildTestApp (empty DB, no demo seed). Web tests colocated *.test.ts.
architecture: packages/shared holds Zod schemas/types as the API/web contract; src/sorting.ts is Zod-free.

API routes are thin (schema in, status out); business logic in src/services as plain functions (db, input). src/plugins: db, error handler, uploads. src/db: schema.ts, client.ts, seed.ts, demo-content.ts.
Drizzle migrations in apps/api/drizzle are generated with db:generate and committed, never hand-edited.

Web: src/api typed fetch functions one file per resource; src/stores Pinia; src/views one per route; src/components by feature (album, crate, forms, profile, admin); src/composables useXxx; src/utils.
Errors shape { statusCode, error, message, issues? }.
conventions.git: Conventional Commits with scope, e.g. feat(api): ...
conventions.ci: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs format:check, lint, typecheck, test, Docker build.

documentation.readme: README.md is current: routes table, scripts, browser checks, accounts, admin, env vars, API endpoint table, layout tree. New endpoints/pages should be added there.
documentation.spec: docs/SPEC.md: Stack, Repo structure, Data model, API, UI/UX, Milestones, Git workflow, Self-hosting.

relevant.closest_analog: The Follows feature (user->user) is the template: table, routes, service, web api module, button component, tests. Favorites mirrors it as user->crate.
db: apps/api/src/db/schema.ts: users, crates (ownerId nullable FK, set null on delete; demoSeedKey; recommendedRank), albums, tracks, follows (id, followerId, followeeId, createdAt; uniqueIndex pair, index followeeId, check no_self, cascade FKs), newsItems; relations blocks; each table needs a data-classification comment. New favorites table (userId, crateId, createdAt, unique pair, cascade both) goes here.
apps/api/drizzle/: latest 0005_follows_news_demo.sql + meta/0005_snapshot.json + meta/_journal.json; generate 0006 with npm run db:generate -w apps/api.
apps/api/test/migration.test.ts and schema.test.ts may need updating.
seed.ts, demo-content.ts, services/demo-seed.ts, db/backup.ts, db/restore.ts: check whether they enumerate tables.
api: apps/api/src/routes/follows.ts: PUT/DELETE /users/:username/follow (204, idempotent), GET /me/following, /me/feed; preValidation signedInOnly so signed-out gets 401 before 400. Pattern for PUT/DELETE /crates/:id/favorite and GET /me/favorites.
apps/api/src/routes/crates.ts and services/crates.ts: getCrate, assertCrateExists, deleteCrate. /crates/recommended declared before /crates/:id.

apps/api/src/routes/profiles.ts and services/profiles.ts: GET /users/:username -> toPublicProfile(db, user, viewerId); profileCrates() selects crates where ownerId = user (created crates); followCounts/isFollowedBy viewer helpers.
apps/api/src/services/admin.ts: admin counts, possibly affected by cascade.
auth: apps/api/src/services/permissions.ts: requireUser, canEditOwner, assertCanEditCrate, requireAdmin. Own-crate rule compares crates.ownerId to req.user.id; legacy crates have ownerId NULL.
relevant.shared: packages/shared/src/index.ts: idParams, usernameParams, crate (ownerId, ownerUsername, ownerDisplayName), crateCard (public, no ownerId), recommendedCrateCard (isDemo), profileCrate (id, name, color, label, albumCount), publicProfile (crates, followerCount, followingCount, viewerFollows, isDemo), publicUser. Rule: public responses never expose numeric user ids, email, role or demo keys.
web: apps/web/src/api/client.ts request<T>(); api/follows.ts is the template for api/favorites.ts; api/crates.ts, api/profiles.ts.
apps/web/src/views/ProfileView.vue (/u/:username): 'Crates' section (h2 Crates, links to route 'crate'), FollowButton with optimistic count. Favorites section goes here, separate from Crates.
apps/web/src/views/CrateView.vue (/shelf and /crates/:id): place for a favorite toggle shown only when the crate is not yours (owner check in apps/web/src/utils/permissions.ts, OwnerLink.vue).
tests_near: API: follows.test.ts (model), profiles.test.ts, shared-profile.test.ts, crates.test.ts, ownership.test.ts, schema.test.ts, migration.test.ts, helpers.ts.
Web: views/ProfileView.test.ts, MyProfileView.test.ts, CrateView.test.ts, crateActions.test.ts, components/profile/FollowButton.test.ts, utils/permissions.test.ts.
